subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

RK-NH-LO

TM-PJ-NQ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given,

**RK → NH → LO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/155e6ab00287bc25ef59db000208fd376986df5e646f71648b2cb8f41196943c.png] 

**TM → PJ → NQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02b093ddc16b7d589460c82cc16082d9dafa4242ad1c450a5071b244eb5b6cf1.png] 

Now, checking the options:

**Option 1) VO → RL → PS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5c9e679f1cab1c1ac6c164a288e775c86c7db714492df9d2c903ad8548a2adb.png] 

**Option 2) VO → RL → PT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13e6b64804438a812f8dce44ea81cd4787e8d5dd6add5d859189196136bb598a.png] 

**Option 3) WO → RL → PT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334682230490b937d671a343491989fd06779a5727fb3c000640b358aadd98b4.png] 

**Option 4) WO → SL → PT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21300dad6774da8fc45a3eb34641c10f2fcd284f3408d84bbea193226ac45b28.png] 

Hence, the triad which strictly follows the same pattern is **Option 1.**
